urdu: عالم پناہ کا لقب کس مغل بادشاہ کے لئے استعمال ہوتا تھا؟
english: Which Mughal emperor was referred to by the title 'Alam Panah'?
roman_1: Alam panah ka laqab kis Mughal badshah ke liye istemal hota tha?
roman_2: Aalam panah ka laqab kis Mughal badshah ke liye istemal hota tha?
roman_3: Alam panah ka laqab kis Mughal baadshah ke liye istemal hota tha?
